title.value: A Comprehensive Dataset of Four Provincial Legislative Assembly Members
title.justification: The title captures the essence of the paper which is about a dataset covering legislative assembly members from four Canadian provinces.
title.quote: This research note reports on a new dataset about legislators in four Canadian provinces since the establishment of their colonial assemblies in the eighteenth century.

analysis.description: The paper reports the creation of a dataset encompassing information about legislators from four Canadian provinces since the eighteenth century. It includes biographical details, electoral performance, and other indicators essential for future research on representation, legislative activities, and party politics.
